# dhi_catalog_repositories (Data Source)

List all DHI catalog repositories with optional type filtering.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `type_filter` (List of String) Filter by repository type. Valid values: `IMAGE`, `HELM_CHART`.

### Read-Only

- `repositories` (Attributes List) List of DHI repositories. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--repositories))

<a id="nestedatt--repositories"></a>
### Nested Schema for `repositories`

Read-Only:

- `display_name` (String) Display name.
- `fips_compliant` (Boolean) FIPS compliant.
- `name` (String) Repository name.
- `namespace` (String) Repository namespace.
- `short_description` (String) Short description.
- `stig_certified` (Boolean) STIG certified.
- `type` (String) Repository type.
